name: Cryohound
description: A dire wolf is a larger and more fearsome version of the common wolf, known for its strength, size, and pack mentality. It is a dominant predator in its environment, capable of taking down large prey with its powerful jaws and coordinated pack tactics.

actions.name: Cold Bite
actions.description: The dire wolf bites a creature, dealing physical and cold damage.

actions.name: Cryobreath
actions.description: The cryowolf emits a breath of frigid air in a 3 unit cone, dealing cold damage. Creatures who take damage from this ability must make a resilience check greater than or equal to the damage dealt after mitigation or become frozen for 1d4 hours. This ability costs 6 power.

actions.name: Fiend Charge
actions.description: Immediately after taking the move action, the cryohound strikes an adjacent creature with their horns, dealing physical damage and knocking the target prone. The damage for this attack is 1d4 for each unit traveled in a straight line.

actions.name: Consume Soul
actions.description: While adjacent to a humanoid or beast that has died within the last minute, the cryohound consumes their soul and gains 3d12 health and 3d12 power. The dead creature cannot be resurrected or returned to life unless until the hellhound is killed, at which point the soul is released.

actions.name: Abyssal Howl
actions.description: Immediately after scoring a true hit, the cryohound lets loose a howl, dealing dark damage to all creatures in a 4 unit radius.

actions.name: Reactive Leap
actions.description: In response to being targeted by a melee attack, the cryohound attempts to leap to an unoccupied tile within 2 units without provoking reactions and gaining a 1d4 bonus to their block or dodge check.
